source_review_notes: Primary XML/PDF results give exact MIC and IC50 values for StpU, StpK, GluC, and GluA against S. aureus RN4220.
Primary text also constrains compounds 3, 8, 9, 11, and 21 as weak/no activity with MIC >=300 ug/mL.
Linked DBAASP rows are present only for StpU and StpK; GluA/GluC activity is retained from primary source without forcing database linkage.

Local supplementary landing-*.bin files are HTML article captures and no structured supplementary tables were locally recoverable; source-supported endpoint values were already available in the article text.
